title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: J. Michael Sturdivant sees one target in Week 12
items.desc: J. Michael Sturdivant failed to catch his only target in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
items.impact: Sturdivant has seen minimal involvement on offense of late, finishing with one reception or less in seven of his last eight contests. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats entering a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Packers D/ST disappoints in Week 12
items.desc: The Packers D/ST recorded one turnover (one interception) while also registering one sack in a 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
items.impact: The defense was victimized by a physical Rams ground attack, allowing 241 rushing yards in the loss. The unit will look to get back on track against an inconsistent New Orleans Saints offense in Week 13.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Trey Smack racks up seven points in Week 12
items.desc: Trey Smack converted both of his field goal attempts as well as his only extra point attempt in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.
items.impact: Smack has fallen victim to inconsistent offensive play of late, recording five points or less in three of his last six contests. The kicker will hope for a more prolific performance in Week 13 against the New Orleans Saints.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Leonard Williams (stinger) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Leonard Williams was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams is on track to have a chance to return for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith-Njigba is managing an ankle issue. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Darnold (quad) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Sam Darnold was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Darnold remains on track to return behind center for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charles Cross (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Charles Cross was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cross remains on track to have a chance to return for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Bradford (knee/illness) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Anthony Bradford was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bradford is managing a knee injury and illness. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Higbee suffers chest injury
items.desc: Tyler Higbee left Wednesday's game against the Packers and did not return with a chest injury.
items.impact: Higbee will have a mini bye week to get fully healthy heading into Week 13.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Christian Watson (concussion) ruled out for remainder of Week 12
items.desc: Christian Watson (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of the Packers' Week 12 game against the Rams after taking a nasty hit by Kam Kinchens.
items.impact: Watson had four receptions for 65 yards and a touchdown before being ruled out. Matthew Golden and Tucker Kraft will lead the Packers receiving options with Watson out.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) inactive for Week 12
items.desc: Zaire Franklin (shin) is inactive for Week 12 for the Green Bay Packers against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Franklin was unable to progress enough throughout the shortened practice week, leaving the Green Bay defense without a key option against a banged-up Rams offense Wednesday night.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) inactive for Week 12
items.desc: Josh Jacobs (finger) is officially inactive for Week 12 for the Green Bay Packers against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Jacobs will miss the Wednesday night contest while continuing to recover from his finger injury, with Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd likely to see the majority of backfield touches against the Rams.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) active for Week 12
items.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) is officially active for Week 12 for the Green Bay Packers against the Los Angeles Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roschon Johnson (ankle) ruled out for Thursday
items.desc: Roschon Johnson has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Salvon Ahmed will remain the RB3 in the Bears backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Gordon (shoulder) ruled out for Thursday
items.desc: Kyler Gordon has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Gordon was unable to practice this week. The Bears secondary will be a little short-handed on Thanksgiving.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colton McKivitz (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The 49ers placed RT Colton McKivitz on injured reserve with an ankle injury.
items.impact: McKivitz went down in Sunday's game against the Vikings. He is expected to miss the rest of the season after fracturing and dislocating his ankle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mike Evans did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is not a huge surprise to see Evans miss practice to begin the week as he continues to manage Achilles tendinitis.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Herbert (concussion) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Justin Herbert did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Herbert was placed in concussion protocol to open the week. His status is up in the air heading into Week 12.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Thompson (hamstring) activated from IR
items.desc: The Cowboys activated S Jalen Thompson from injured reserve.
items.impact: Thompson makes his return after suffering a hamstring injury in Week 3.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pittman has logged back-to-back full practices. He remains on track to be good to go to return from injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kedon Slovis claimed off waivers by Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals claimed QB Kedon Slovis off waivers.
items.impact: Slovis returns to Arizona after he was waived by Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam LaPorta (ankle) off injury report Thursday
items.desc: Sam LaPorta is off the injury report for Thursday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: LaPorta will be a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) off injury report for Thursday
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. is off the injury report for Thursday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Reed will be a full-go on Thanksgiving day on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Likely (groin) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Isaiah Likely was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Likely played through the injury last week after he had been a late addition to the injury report. He should still be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Williams (ribs) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Isaiah Williams was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams did not play last Sunday. His status remains uncertain heading into Week 12.
